selection_rule: Minimum full-validation valid-pixel CE; exact ties choose earliest epoch
organ_interpretation: ID5 is interpreted as Prostate under the user-accepted assumption that the course derivative preserves source label IDs; derivative no-remapping is not independently verified
aggregation: Pool valid-pixel confusion counts over the entire validation split; not per-case/volume balanced or average batch Dice
resource_scope: Training, validation and checkpoint restoration are reported separately. Peaks include each stage's documented resident state and allocator cache, not total GPU VRAM. Run elapsed also contains inter-stage checkpoint/plot/report work.
training_wall_clock_note: Training-stage wall time includes input I/O and metric computation. Model-run order and filesystem/cache state were not isolated, so differences in total training time cannot be attributed to architecture-only compute speed. Use the separate warmed-up synthetic forward profile for pure forward comparisons.

resident_state_descriptions: Training model, Adam state (created on first updates), gradients, batch inputs/outputs/activations. Prior allocations and cached reserved blocks remain resident.
training.scope: Maximum absolute PyTorch allocator peak within this phase; includes stated resident objects and cached reserved memory. Not a delta, total GPU VRAM or an isolated optimizer-free model measurement.

resident_state_descriptions: Same model plus resident Adam state and last training gradients; validation inputs/outputs; eval and no optimizer updates. Cached reserved blocks remain included.

scope.timing_includes: Model forward, Python/host launch and post-forward synchronization overhead; CUDA synchronized before and after each iteration
scope.timing_excludes: Checkpoint loading, model/input construction, transfers, warmup, metrics, output deletion, plotting and report I/O
scope.memory_includes: Resident model/input, transient outputs and forward temporaries during the timed stage; reserved memory includes allocator cache retained from this combination's setup/warmup
scope.memory_excludes: Checkpoint restoration and an optimizer; not total GPU VRAM or training memory
scope.cache_policy: Before each combination, free unused CUDA cache after synchronization, then construct input and warm up; do not clear warmup cache inside the timed stage
scope.cpu_note: CPU timing is supported; CUDA memory values are unavailable on CPU and must not be interpreted as zero GPU usage.

claim_boundary: One seed and one fixed 20-epoch budget on the available train/validation splits. Not test performance, case-balanced performance, statistical significance, an ablation or a substitute for new results using old project scores.
conclusion: Under this predeclared CE-checkpoint protocol, baseline has higher selected-checkpoint validation ID5 Dice and fewer parameters. This result does not demonstrate an Improved ID5 gain; later-epoch ID5 maxima are not substituted for CE-selected weights. The experiment is one seed with four case proxy groups in validation, not an independent test or general architecture ranking.
